papers.title: Texture and anisotropy in selective laser melting of NiTi alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: Sasan Dadbakhsh
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究NiTi合金选区激光熔化的织构与各向异性，未涉及多孔结构或生物相容性验证。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stiffness matching, does not include fatigue testing, and does not discuss osseointegration or surface properties for biomedical use.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化NiTi合金的织构形成机制及其对力学各向异性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过EBSD表征织构，结合拉伸和压缩实验分析各向异性行为。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了SLM工艺参数对织构类型和各向异性程度的调控作用。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观组织表征和力学测试验证了织构与性能的关联。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the formation of crystallographic texture in selective laser melted NiTi alloy and its effect on mechanical anisotropy.
summary_en.method: Electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) was used to characterize texture, and tensile and compression tests were performed to evaluate anisotropy.
summary_en.result: The study demonstrated that SLM process parameters significantly influence texture type and the degree of mechanical anisotropy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification for a sailing yacht hull, using multi-fidelity kriging

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的多保真克里金方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但应用领域为船舶流体动力学。
llm.why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no structural mechanics or contact mechanics; no experimental validation in biomedical domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效量化帆船船体性能的不确定性，降低高保真仿真成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用多保真克里金法融合低保真和高保真CFD数据构建代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 多保真方法在保持精度的同时显著减少高保真仿真次数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过帆船船体阻力的CFD仿真案例验证代理模型预测能力。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify uncertainty in sailing yacht hull performance while reducing the computational cost of high-fidelity simulations.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity kriging surrogate model is constructed by fusing low-fidelity and high-fidelity CFD data.
summary_en.result: The multi-fidelity approach significantly reduces the number of high-fidelity simulations while maintaining prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate model is validated on a sailing yacht hull resistance CFD simulation case.

papers.title: A visual active learning system for the assessment of patient well-being in prostate cancer research
papers.abstract: The assessment of patient well-being is highly relevant for the early detection of diseases, for assessing the risks of therapies, or for evaluating therapy outcomes. The knowledge to assess a patient's well-being is actually tacit knowledge and thus, can only be used by the physicians themselves. The rationale of this research approach is to use visual interfaces to capture the mental models of experts and make them available more explicitly. We present a visual active learning system that enables physicians to label the well-being state of patient histories suffering prostate cancer. The labeled instances are iteratively learned in an active learning approach. In addition, the system provides models and visual interfaces for a) estimating the number of patients needed for learning, b) suggesting meaningful learning candidates and c) visual feedback on test candidates. We present the results of two evaluation strategies that prove the validity of the applied model. In a representative real-world use case, we learned the feedback of physicians on a data collection of more than 16.000 prostate cancer histories.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注前列腺癌患者健康评估的主动学习系统，与FEA及代理模型方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 将医生评估患者健康的隐性知识显式化
summary_zh.method: 开发视觉主动学习系统，迭代标注患者病史并学习模型
summary_zh.result: 在超过16000例前列腺癌数据上验证了模型有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过两种评估策略验证模型有效性

summary_en.motivation: To externalize tacit knowledge of physicians in assessing patient well-being for prostate cancer.
summary_en.method: A visual active learning system is developed to iteratively label patient histories and learn a model.
summary_en.result: The model's validity is demonstrated on a dataset of over 16,000 prostate cancer histories.
summary_en.validation: Two evaluation strategies confirm the model's validity in a real-world use case.

papers.title: Impact of the Femoral Head Position on Moment Arms in Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Parametric Finite Element Study

summary_zh.method: 建立参数化有限元模型，改变股骨头位置参数

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how femoral head position affects muscle moment arms after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A parametric finite element model was developed by varying femoral head position parameters.
summary_en.result: Femoral head position significantly alters abductor and iliopsoas moment arms.
summary_en.validation: Model trends were validated against literature data.

papers.title: Migration and strains induced by different designs of force-closed stems for THA
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVES: Subtle differences in stem design can result in different mechanical responses of the total hip arthroplasty. Tests measuring migration of the stem relative to the femur, as well as the strains in the cement mantle and on the femur can detect different mechanical behavior between stems. METHODS: In this article, conical, double and triple tapered stems were implanted in composite femurs and subjected to static and cyclic loads. Stems differed mainly on taper angle, calcar radius and proximal stiffness. Stem migration and strains on the femur and in the cement mantle were achieved. RESULTS: Significant differences (p < 0.05) were noted in the permanent rotation between double and triple tapers, in the strains on the proximal medial femur between triple and both conical and double tapers, and in the strains on the lateral proximal femur between double tapers and both conical and triple tapers. CONCLUSION: The proposed mechanical tests were able to detect significant differences in the behavior of these resembling stems. Stem proximal stiffness and the calcar radius of the stem influence its rotational stability and the strain transmission to the femur.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接测量了不同设计THA股骨柄的迁移和股骨应变，与用户研究方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include patient-specific geometry or FEA validation, and does not report micromotion values with contact/friction modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较不同锥度设计股骨柄的力学行为差异。
summary_zh.method: 将三种锥度柄植入复合股骨，施加静态和循环载荷测量迁移和应变。
summary_zh.result: 双锥与三锥柄的永久旋转、近端内侧和外侧股骨应变存在显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过复合股骨实验验证，统计显著性检验。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how subtle differences in stem taper design affect mechanical responses in total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Conical, double, and triple tapered stems were implanted in composite femurs and subjected to static and cyclic loads while measuring migration and strains.
summary_en.result: Significant differences in permanent rotation and proximal femoral strains were found between stem designs, influenced by proximal stiffness and calcar radius.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing on composite femurs with statistical significance testing.

papers.title: An Agent Based Catalog Integration System through Active Learning
papers.venue: International Journal of Computer Trends and Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文与有限元代理建模方向无关，不涉及任何仿真或优化方法。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about agent-based catalog integration and active learning for data integration, with no FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出基于智能体的目录集成系统以提高数据整合效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习方法优化智能体间的数据集成过程。
summary_zh.result: 系统能够有效整合异构数据源。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of data integration across heterogeneous catalogs using an agent-based approach.
summary_en.method: An active learning strategy is employed to optimize the integration process among multiple agents.
summary_en.result: The proposed system effectively integrates data from diverse sources.

papers.title: The Design Conference Model and Its Learning Environment: A Construction Site
papers.abstract: As an echo to Johan Verbeke's text 'Designing Academic Conferences as a Learning Environment: How to Stimulate Active Learning at Academic Conferences?', I propose the notion of a construction site as a constructive metaphor for dynamically revisiting the template of research conferences and events in the field of art and design.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论艺术与设计领域的会议模式，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is about conference design in art and design education, with no mention of FEA, surrogate modeling, optimization, uncertainty quantification, or any engineering or biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 重新思考艺术与设计领域学术会议的形式
summary_zh.method: 提出‘施工现场’作为动态重构会议模式的隐喻
summary_zh.result: 倡导主动学习与参与式会议设计

summary_en.motivation: To rethink the format of academic conferences in art and design as active learning environments.
summary_en.method: Proposes the metaphor of a 'construction site' to dynamically reconfigure conference templates.
summary_en.result: Advocates for participatory and active learning-oriented conference design.
